title: Wrong name for „Bond BT device on Android 15+ …“ option
body: Hello, the Bond option for Android 15 only has the name „Bond BT device on Android 15+ (Pixel phones workaround)“. The „+“ sign should be removed (in AAPS), because Android 15+ means Android 15 and greater. That’s not correct, because only Android 15 has the problems and needs this option to be enabled. Please see this site https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/GettingHelp/GeneralTroubleshooting.html

comments.body: @MilosKozak this issue can be closed now.
